## What changes for users?

Explain the problem, the behavior after this change, and any limitations.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated a regression test for changed behavior, or explained why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] Automated checks pass.
- [ ] Checked affected student/TA views, tool frames, Aether OFF, keyboard interaction, and narrow layouts where applicable.
- [ ] Screenshots and fixtures contain only fictional or redacted data.
- [ ] Updated user-facing documentation if needed.

For a new preview format, also check invalid, oversized, inaccessible, and cancelled reads. For dependency changes, preserve licenses and provenance.
